vars.title: Collectors
vars.sub: Bring files into Research’s queue on a schedule. The queue batches them like anything you drop.

states.label: A · No collectors yet: add one of the two kinds
B · Add collector: pick Built-in → Folder, or Custom script
C · New Folder collector: defaults filled in (~/Distill Inbox, every hour, Research)
D · Folder: source, target queue, schedule, last run, history
D2 · Already collected: what Distill remembers, Forget one to collect it again
E · Folder running (Run now or on schedule)
F · Run history: each file Copied, Skipped · already collected, or Waiting
G · Error: the source folder is missing (this collector is set to Move)
H · Error: no permission to read the folder
I · New custom script (inline zsh): waits for your OK before it ever runs
J · Custom script from a file: interpreter, schedule with cron preview, timeout, what it gets
K · Run log: succeeded, timed out, failed with stderr
L · Script running: live output, Stop
M · Error: the script failed (exit 1, stderr)
N · Not trusted: the script changed since you allowed it
In the queue
states.caption: Collected files are ordinary queue rows; the meta line names the collector. They wait the usual 10 minutes after they last changed, so a script that is still writing is never batched half-done.

boards.title: Collectors · list, add, Folder collector
boards.heading: Collectors · built-in Folder
boards.intro: Collectors bring material into the queue automatically, on a schedule. Collectors is a sidebar item under Queue because it feeds it. Two kinds: built-in (code ships in Distill; you set a folder, query, token and schedule; the first one is Folder) and custom script (your code, run like a cron job). Folder copies every file from a folder you pick into the vault’s queue folder (~/Distill Inbox by default) and leaves the original in place; After collecting: Move it to the queue is the option. Because originals stay, the ledger is what keeps each run from copying the same files again: the core remembers every file it took (path, size, mtime, sha256) in its state folder, a file whose content is already there is Skipped · already collected, and the detail shows Already collected: 128 files with View… and Forget. It leaves hidden files, subfolders, and files changed in the last 10 minutes (the batching settle wait). Collectors only fill the queue; nothing reaches the vault before your review.

boards.title: Collectors · custom script (consent, schedule, run log)
boards.heading: Collectors · custom script
boards.intro: A custom collector runs your script on a schedule. Source: a file, or inline code in the editor; interpreter zsh, python3 or node. It gets the vault path and the queue folder path as $1 / $2 and as DISTILL_VAULT / DISTILL_QUEUE_DIR, runs in a fresh temporary working folder, and should write files only into the queue folder. Schedule: presets or a cron expression with a plain-English preview. Timeout (default 5 minutes). Every run is logged with exit code, duration, files added and its stdout/stderr. Nothing runs before you allow it: “Distill will run this code on your Mac as you”. The allowance is tied to the script’s sha256, so a changed script is paused until you allow it again. Scripts never run as part of processing notes, and Distill does not sandbox their network access.
